subject.title: Bug: partialArgs JSON duplication in agentTurn cron jobs with isolated sessionTarget

question: Should OpenClaw repair only semantically identical duplicated complete tool-call argument objects, or change the provider stream contract for cumulative argument chunks?
rationale: The choice controls how malformed provider output becomes executable file or command tool arguments, and the existing open PR shows that a broad first-object-wins repair can silently discard conflicting arguments.

options.title: Repair Identical Duplicates
options.body: Accept only repeated JSON objects that are semantically identical to the first parsed arguments, with conflicts still failing closed.

options.title: Change Stream Contract
options.body: Treat affected provider chunks as cumulative snapshots, but require live provider proof and compatibility checks for normal incremental providers.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed
options.body: Leave duplicated structured suffixes rejected until maintainers accept a narrower or better-proven repair.

recommendation.title: Repair Identical Duplicates
recommendation.body: Accept only repeated JSON objects that are semantically identical to the first parsed arguments, with conflicts still failing closed.

likelyOwner.reason: The malformed tool-call recovery history and recent helper maintenance make this the strongest routing signal for the repair-semantics decision.
